{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2014–15 |team = Bowling Green Falcons | image = Bowling Green Falcons wordmark.svg | image_size = 250 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = East Division |short_conf = MAC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 21–12 |conf_record = 11–7 |head_coach = [[Chris Jans]] |hc_year = 1st |asst_coach1 = David Ragland |asst_coach2 = Mark Downey |asst_coach3 = Corey Barker |stadium = [[Stroh Center]] |champion = |bowl = [[2015 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] |bowl_result = Second round }} {{2014–15 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team''' represented [[Bowling Green State University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Falcons, led by first year head coach [[Chris Jans]] in his only season, played their home games at the [[Stroh Center]] as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 11–7 in MAC play to finish in third place in the East Division. They advanced to the second round of the [[2015 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] where they lost to Eastern Michigan.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/400768035|title=Lee scores 27, Eastern Michigan beats Bowling Green 73-67|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 11, 2015|access-date=February 17, 2024}} They received an invitation to the [[2015 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]] where they defeated Saint Francis (PA) in the first round before losing in the second round to Canisius. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2014|team=Bowling Green Falcons|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Josh|last=Gomez|num=0|pos=C|ft=6|in=10|lbs=226|class=JR|rs=y|home=[[Bronx|Bronx, NY]]|high_school=[[Rice High School (Manhattan)|Rice HS]]
